title: Atom & Structure
summary: An atom is the smallest unit of an element that retains the chemical properties of that element. It consists of a nucleus (protons and neutrons) surrounded by electrons in orbitals.
sample_question: What are the three main subatomic particles and where are they located in the atom?

title: Periodic Table
summary: The periodic table organizes elements by increasing atomic number and groups elements with similar chemical properties into columns called groups or families.
sample_question: How does atomic radius change across a period (left to right) and why?

title: Chemical Bonding
summary: Atoms form chemical bonds to achieve stable electron configurations. Major bonding types include ionic, covalent, and metallic bonds, each with distinct properties.
sample_question: What is the key difference between ionic and covalent bonds?

title: Acids & Bases
summary: Acids donate protons (H+) and bases accept protons. pH measures acidity; strong acids/bases dissociate completely in solution while weak ones do not.
sample_question: What is pH and how does it relate to H+ concentration in a solution?
